<style id="hojaR16SteppedTeamScoreplates">
/* R16: left-column teams are mirrored ㄴ, right-column teams are ㄴ.
   One contour per joined score+name silhouette; score/portrait remain a rigid unit. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore{
  box-sizing:border-box!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;width:100%!important;
  height:clamp(78px,12.4vh,118px)!important;bottom:4px!important;
  min-height:0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;display:block!important;
  overflow:visible!important;isolation:isolate;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore.active{
  background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreContour{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;
  display:block;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 0 rgba(3,15,24,.57)) drop-shadow(0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.32));
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreShapePath{
  fill:rgba(8,27,40,.94);stroke:var(--team);stroke-width:3.5;
  stroke-linejoin:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;transition:fill .2s,stroke .2s;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active .htScoreShapePath{
  fill:#fffaf1;stroke:var(--team);stroke-width:4.5;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,221,115,.75));
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreZone,
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htNameZone{
  position:absolute;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:0 3px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:visible;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreZone{
  left:0;top:0;width:60%;height:100%;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htNameZone{
  right:0;top:56%;width:40%;height:44%;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htLeft .htScoreZone{left:40%;right:0;}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htLeft .htNameZone{left:0;right:auto;}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamPts{
  display:block!important;width:100%;white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:var(--htScoreFont,70px)!important;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums!important;line-height:1!important;
  text-align:center!important;letter-spacing:-.055em!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamName{
  display:block!important;width:100%;white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:var(--htNameFont,18px)!important;
  line-height:1.1!important;min-width:0!important;flex:none!important;
  overflow:visible!important;letter-spacing:-.05em!important;
  text-align:center!important;
}
/* Existing R7 separate-card animation is disabled: animate the R11 composite unit only. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore.scoreGain,
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore.scoreLoss{
  animation:none!important;translate:none!important;scale:1!important;filter:none!important;
}
/* The original R5 ember now uses EXACTLY the same SVG silhouette path coordinates. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active>.htFuseSpark{
  /* R16A: Without explicit left/top, an auto-positioned spark gets a
     static-position X origin at card.width/2. CSS path() is then shifted
     horizontally by half the card width after every resize. Fix origin. */
  left:0!important;top:0!important;
  offset-path:var(--htScoreTrace)!important;offset-rotate:0deg!important;
  animation:htFuseRunR5 1.4s linear infinite!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamPortrait{z-index:4!important;}
@media(max-width:900px){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore{height:clamp(64px,11.5vh,95px)!important;bottom:3px!important;}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit>.htTeamScore{height:clamp(49px,10vh,72px)!important;bottom:1px!important;}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreZone,#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htNameZone{padding:0 1px;}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScoreShapePath{stroke-width:2.5;}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamScore.active>.htFuseSpark{animation-duration:3s!important;}
}
</style>
<style id="hojaR17FCorrectImpactStyles">
/* R17F: success hit feedback before pipes; FX layer stays pointer-transparent and topmost. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htFxLayer .htCorrectImpact{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:90;display:grid;place-items:center;
  pointer-events:none;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(21,101,76,.80),rgba(4,17,30,.91) 60%,rgba(4,13,22,.94));
  animation:htCorrectHitFlash .78s ease both;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectImpactInner{
  display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2;min-width:320px;max-width:94%;
  padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,32px) clamp(40px,5vw,78px);text-align:center;color:#fff4c8;
  border:3px solid #b8efb3;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(4,39,40,.87);
  box-shadow:0 10px 0 #001923,0 0 38px #8fe46d66;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 0 #0b2d36) drop-shadow(0 0 16px #ffe97e99);
  animation:htCorrectHitText .78s cubic-bezier(.17,1.45,.35,1) both;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectImpactTitle{
  font:1000 clamp(76px,9.8vw,148px)/1.05 system-ui,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif;
  -webkit-text-stroke:clamp(1px,.15vw,2.5px) #1f5a49;
  letter-spacing:-.065em;text-shadow:4px 5px 0 #0d6147,0 0 22px #f8e26faa;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectImpactSub{
  font:900 clamp(15px,1.8vw,27px)/1.2 system-ui,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif;
  color:#fffdf1;margin-top:14px;letter-spacing:.02em;
  text-shadow:0 3px 0 #14534b;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectSpark{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:48%;z-index:1;
  width:clamp(7px,1vw,17px);height:clamp(7px,1vw,17px);background:#fff1a0;
  clip-path:polygon(50% 0,62% 39%,100% 50%,62% 61%,50% 100%,38% 61%,0 50%,38% 39%);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px #fff19c;opacity:0;
  animation:htCorrectSparkBurst .72s ease-out both;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
}
@keyframes htCorrectHitFlash{0%{opacity:0}12%{opacity:1}78%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes htCorrectHitText{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.75) translateY(-8px)}
  22%{opacity:1;transform:scale(.91) translateY(0)}
  38%{transform:scale(1.045)}60%{transform:scale(1)}
  86%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.98) translateY(-9px)}
}
@keyframes htCorrectSparkBurst{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(0) scale(.2)}
  20%{opacity:1}
  80%{opacity:1}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--angle)) translateX(var(--dist)) scale(.38)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectImpact,
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectImpactInner,
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htCorrectSpark{animation:none!important;opacity:1!important;}
}
</style>

<style id="hojaR17KTutorialOverlayCSS">
#hojaTutOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:#0b111e;color:#fff}
#hojaTutOverlay[hidden]{display:none!important}
#hojaTutOverlay>iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;border:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#0b111e}
/* Move the actual shared controls into the overlay; no extra tutorial buttons. */
#hojaTutOverlay > #hojaSharedBack{left:14px!important;top:12px!important;display:block!important;z-index:100!important}
#hojaTutOverlay > #hojaAudioTop{left:119px!important;top:12px!important;display:flex!important;z-index:100!important}
@media(max-width:660px){#hojaTutOverlay > #hojaSharedBack{left:8px!important;top:8px!important}
#hojaTutOverlay > #hojaAudioTop{left:91px!important;top:8px!important}}
</style>
<div id="hojaTutOverlay" hidden><iframe id="hojaTutApp" title="호자 연습모드" allow="autoplay; fullscreen" allowfullscreen></iframe><span id="hojaTutStatus" hidden role="status" aria-live="polite"></span></div>
<script id="hojaR17PTutorialHostSpaceRelay">
/* Only for the in-progress Stage 0 tutorial dialogue when focus is on the host HUD. */
(function(){
 let nativeDialogueOpen=false;
 window.addEventListener('message',function(e){
  const o=document.getElementById('hojaTutOverlay'),f=document.getElementById('hojaTutApp');
  if(!o||o.hidden||e.source!==f?.contentWindow)return;
  if(e.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUT_DIALOGUE_STATE'&&e.data.zone==='native')nativeDialogueOpen=!!e.data.open;
 });
 window.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  const o=document.getElementById('hojaTutOverlay'),f=document.getElementById('hojaTutApp');
  if(!nativeDialogueOpen||!o||o.hidden||!f?.contentWindow)return;
  const k=e.code||(e.key===' '?'Space':e.key);
  if(k!=='Enter')return;   // 40-6BG: dialogue = click / Enter (Space removed, as in the arcade)
  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  if(e.repeat)return;
  f.contentWindow.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TUT_REMOTE_DIALOG_NEXT'},'*');
 },true);
})();
</script>
<script type="application/octet-stream" id="hojaR17KTutorialGzip">
